title: rubus hirtus var. lengyelii
intro: Rubus hirtus var. lengyelii, commonly known as a type of black raspberry, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. The therapeutic actions of Rubus hirtus var. lengyelii include its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
